reviewer.type: separate AI reviewer plus deterministic local checks
reviewer.relationship_to_inputs: Reviewer authored the development fixtures; not an independent human gold evaluation.

scope.codex_cli_limitation: The controller reported a read-only filesystem failure when starting the separate Codex CLI process; see corpus-lab/DIAGNOSTICS-V10.md. This delegated-runtime pilot does not resolve or bypass that limitation.

controller_report.input_policy: exactly one opaque case file per agent, with no clean/flawed or expected-decision label

directly_verified: All four output artifacts exist and parse as JSON.
Source hashes agree with the opaque input files, mapping file, and longform fixture.
Opaque input keys are amac, tur, kaynak and id; no seeded_defects, decision, protected_facts or pair label.
All output and artifact hashes were recomputed.
not_independently_audited: Full agent conversation and filesystem access trace.
Whether every reference listed was actually read or every tool invocation succeeded.
Exact backend model version, random seed, temperature and run order.
protocol_evidence.isolation_interpretation: Fresh context according to controller protocol, not forensic proof of all filesystem accesses or model-level independence.

excluded_shared_context_pilot.reason: One shared input contained clean and flawed forms of each of two articles, and the IDs exposed clean/flawed labels. The clean counterpart could serve as an answer key. Any apparent repair success cannot be attributed to an independent edit of one source.

methods.byte_equivalence: Exact Python string equality after JSON decoding, no normalization or stripping. Source and output hashes are UTF-8 SHA-256.
methods.word_count: Python str.split; punctuation remains attached and standalone punctuation counts as a token.
methods.edit_hunks: difflib.SequenceMatcher over whitespace tokens, autojunk=False; descriptive alignment, not Levenshtein distance.
methods.character_similarity: difflib.SequenceMatcher.ratio on characters, autojunk=False; not a quality or meaning score.
methods.text_blocks: Split on two newline characters, including headings.
methods.seed_assessment: Remove or repair the four known seeded spans, inspect the replacement meaning, then examine residual changes. Canonical clean wording is not the only valid repair.
methods.semantic_assessment: AI reading of protected facts, negation, uncertainty, causal restraint, fictional status, narrative sequence and all changed spans. Not a human rating.
methods.tool_provenance: Raw output metadata is copied as reported. Missing tools_used on baseline is unknown, not zero tool calls.

runtime_metadata.tools_list_presence: not recorded; do not interpret as no tool use
runtime_metadata.evidence_level: self-reported artifact metadata, not an independent execution trace audit

limitations: Only one underlying article, represented by two source variants; four outputs and one sample per condition.
All source text, editing and substantive reviewing are AI-produced; no human preference or human authorship gold.
The review is not blind; the reviewer knows arms, expected decisions and seeded defects.
The reviewer authored the development source fixtures, so external validation is still absent.
No exposed exact model/backend version, seed, temperature or full independent tool trace.
The comparison bundles skill instructions, selected references and reported tools; it does not identify which component caused a difference.
No statistical dominance, general Turkish-quality conclusion, detector evasion claim or full Codex CLI qualification follows.
The original shared-context pilot is excluded even though its raw artifacts remain for audit.
